================================================================================
============== AI / LLM APPLICATION SECURITY AUDIT (FortiOS 8.0) ===============
================================================================================

  This module audits controls over AI/LLM traffic including:
  ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Claude, Copilot, DeepSeek, and AI APIs.
  Covers: LLM profiles, DLP coverage, App Control, Web Filter, Data Sovereignty.

|                  AI Security Controls Summary                 |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+
| LLM profiles configured    | 1                                |
| Policies with LLM profile  | 0/3                              |
| Policies with DLP profile  | 0/3                              |
| Policies with CASB profile | 0/3                              |
| App control profiles       | 1                                |
| Web filter profiles        | 1                                |
+---------------------------------------------------------------+

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  FINDINGS
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  🟡 [MEDIUM]
  AI/LLM Audit: LLM profiles are defined but none are attached to any firewall policy — AI traffic inspection is configured but not enforced.

  🟠 [HIGH]
  LLM Profile 'corp-ai-policy': dlp-check disabled — sensitive corporate data in AI prompts (source code, customer PII, financial data) exits the network without inspection. Enable: set dlp-check enable

  🟠 [HIGH]
  LLM Profile 'corp-ai-policy': pii-check disabled — PII (names, SSNs, emails, credit cards) may be submitted to external AI services in violation of GDPR/HIPAA/PCI-DSS. Enable: set pii-check enable

  🟡 [MEDIUM]
  LLM Profile 'corp-ai-policy': prompt-injection-check disabled — adversarial prompts could manipulate AI systems connected through this policy.

  🟡 [MEDIUM]
  LLM Profile 'corp-ai-policy': jailbreak-check disabled — attempts to bypass AI safety controls not detected.

  🟡 [MEDIUM]
  LLM Profile 'corp-ai-policy': logging disabled — AI traffic events not recorded for forensics or compliance audits.

  🟡 [MEDIUM]
  AI/LLM Audit: only 0% of accept policies have DLP profiles — without DLP, users can freely paste source code, customer data, and internal documents into AI services like ChatGPT.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  RECOMMENDED AI GOVERNANCE FRAMEWORK
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  1. IDENTIFY: Enable App Control with AI app signatures to see what AI
     tools your users are already using (monitor mode first).

  2. CLASSIFY: Tier AI services:
     - Approved corporate tools (M365 Copilot, approved ChatGPT Enterprise)
     - Conditionally permitted (with DLP + logging)
     - Blocked (Chinese AI, consumer tools, unapproved APIs)

  3. CONTROL:
     config llm profile
         edit Corporate-AI-Policy
             set dlp-check enable
             set pii-check enable
             set prompt-injection-check enable
             set jailbreak-check enable
             set log enable
         next
     end

  4. BLOCK sovereignty-risk AI via web filter URL filter:
     deepseek.com, ernie.baidu.com, qwen.ai, kimi.moonshot.cn
